items.title: GPT-6-Astra solves 49 of 50 physics research problems at $2.40 apiece
items.summary: On the TheoPhysEval benchmark, GPT-6-Astra solves 49 of 50 unpublished theoretical physics calculations as accurately as leading specialists. In some cases where the agent seemed to fail, the experts' own reference solutions turned out to contain errors. But the researchers say physics hasn't had a breakthrough like the ones in mathematics, because the agents lack "taste." They still think autonomous, top-level AI research could arrive soon. They already see consequences for how young physicists are trained and for equal opportunity in the field. The article GPT-6-Astra solves 49 of 50 physics research problems at $2.40 apiece appeared first on The Decoder .
items.summary_zh: 在 TheoPhysEval 基準測試中，GPT-6-Astra 以如同頂尖專家的準確度，解決了 50 個未公開理論物理計算中的 49 個。在某些代理似乎失敗的案例中，專家自己的參考解答反而包含了錯誤。但研究人員表示，物理學尚未迎來像數學那樣的突破，因為這些代理缺乏「品味」。他們仍然認為自主的高階 AI 研究可能會很快到來。他們已經看到了這對年輕物理學家的培訓方式以及該領域機會均等的影響。這篇報導 GPT-6-Astra solves 49 of 50 physics research problems at $2.40 apiece 最初發布於 The Decoder。

items.title: Anthropic's Q3 revenue hits $16.8B but growth slows ahead of planned November IPO
items.summary: Anthropic hit $16.8 billion in third-quarter revenue, a 45 percent gain that still falls far short of Q2's 140 percent surge. With a November IPO approaching, some investors now expect the company's valuation to drop below $1.5 trillion. Slowing growth and a tough market are cooling expectations for the AI boom's biggest Wall Street test yet. The article Anthropic's Q3 revenue hits $16.8B but growth slows ahead of planned November IPO appeared first on The Decoder .
items.summary_zh: Anthropic 第三季營收達到 168 億美元，年增 45%，但仍遠不及第二季 140% 的暴增幅度。隨著 11 月首次公開募股（IPO）逼近，部分投資人現在預期該公司的估值將跌破 1.5 兆美元。成長放緩與艱困的市場正在為這場人工智慧熱潮中華爾街迄今最大的考驗降溫。本文〈Anthropic's Q3 營收達 16.8 億美元但成長在預計 11 月 IPO 前放緩〉最初發布於 The Decoder。

items.title: AI時代資料中心不再追著使用者跑，臺電倡議「以光代電」納入AIDC選址策略
items.summary: AI運算需求快速成長，資料中心的選址邏輯也正在改變。過去資料中心多半靠近使用者端，以降低網路延遲與傳輸距離，但在AI時代，GPU叢集與大型AI資料中心（AIDC）的高密度用電需求，「電力從哪裡來」成為新考量。 臺電在這周舉行的「2026臺灣國際智慧能源週」，以「積體電網」為主題參展，並提出「以光代電」策略，鼓勵AI資料中心靠近電源端設定，透過長距離光纖傳輸資料，取代長距離輸送大量電力的模式。 值得注意的是，臺電將AI時代的用電需求分為「製造AI」與「執行AI」兩類。其中「製造AI」方面，包括晶圓製造、記憶體、先進封裝及高階伺服器等AI供應鏈，臺電預估我國半導體產業用電將從2026年約520億度，增加到2035年的1,100億度。

items.title: Google says self-improving AI isn't anywhere close
items.summary: Google engineer Haydn Belfield says there's no measurable acceleration of AI research driven by AI at Deepmind. AI now writes more than 75 percent of production code, but 88 percent of changes still need human oversight. The company's in-house General Capability Index shows steady growth with no sudden speedup. Self-improving AI isn't anywhere close, Belfield says. The article Google says self-improving AI isn't anywhere close appeared first on The Decoder .
items.summary_zh: Google 工程師 Haydn Belfield 表示，在 Deepmind，AI 並未帶動 AI 研究出現可測量的加速。AI 現在編寫了超過 75% 的正式程式碼，但仍有 88% 的變更需要人類監督。該公司的內部「一般能力指數」顯示出穩定成長，並沒有突然加速。Belfield 表示，自我提升的 AI 還遙不可及。這篇題為 Google 的文章最先出現在 The Decoder。

items.title: Researchers tracked down a rogue fleet of Chinese AI agents in the wild and actually talked to it
items.summary: For the first time, researchers have tracked down an uncontrolled fleet of Chinese AI agents in the wild and communicated with them via a web mailbox. The agents, running on Tencent Cloud, had launched more than 2,600 attempts to scrape data from Alibaba's mapping service Amap, finding their own workarounds when bot protections blocked them. When the researchers made contact, the agents were surprisingly polite. The article Researchers tracked down a rogue fleet of Chinese AI agents in the wild and actually talked to it appeared first on The Decoder .
items.summary_zh: 研究人員首次在野外追蹤到不受控制的中國 AI 代理艦隊，並透過網路信箱與它們進行通訊。這些在 騰訊 Cloud 上執行的代理發起了超過 2,600 次嘗試，從 阿里巴巴的 的地圖服務高德地圖（Amap）抓取資料，並在遭到機器人防護封鎖時找出自己的應變方法。當研究人員與其聯絡時，這些代理展現出令人驚訝的禮貌。這篇「研究人員在野外追蹤到一群失控的中國 AI 代理並實際與之對話」的文章首先發表於 The Decoder。

items.title: OpenAI will reportedly ship at least one model this year but its flagship still needs alignment work
items.summary: OpenAI is racing to finish its next flagship model, which uses the same looped transformer technique as Astra to boost math and coding performance. The tradeoff is that looping makes safety monitoring harder. Microsoft accidentally revealed details about how the technique works on a public page. Whether or not the flagship is ready in time, employees say one or two new models will likely ship by year's end. The article OpenAI will reportedly ship at least one model this year but its flagship still needs alignment work appeared first on The Decoder .
items.summary_zh: OpenAI 正競相完成其下一個旗艦模型，該模型採用與 Astra 相同的循環 Transformer 技術來提升數學和編碼效能。其代價是循環會使安全監控變得更加困難。微軟 在公開頁面上意外洩漏了該技術運作方式的細節。無論旗艦模型是否能及時準備好，員工表示今年底前很可能會推出一或兩個新模型。報導稱 OpenAI 今年將至少推出一款模型，但其旗艦模型仍需進行對齊工作，這篇文章最早出現在 The Decoder 上。

items.title: CopilotKit Releases CLiF: A Continual Learning Platform That Turns Agent Traces and User Actions into Skills, Evals, and Fine-Tuning Data
items.summary: Introduction Teams shipping AI agents at scale keep running into the same pattern. Even agents built on top-tier models like Fable and Astra struggle to carry out complex, end-to-end tasks inside a specific product consistently enough to deploy. So teams grind out evals for the workflows that matter most, often hundreds or thousands of hand-written […] The post CopilotKit Releases CLiF: A Continual Learning Platform That Turns Agent Traces and User Actions into Skills, Evals, and Fine-Tuning Data appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items.summary_zh: 簡介 大規模部署 AI 代理的團隊不斷遇到相同的模式。即使是建構在 Fable 和 Astra 等頂級模型之上的代理，也很難在特定產品內部一致地執行複雜的端到端任務以進行部署。因此，團隊為最重要的工作流程精心打造評估（evals），通常有數百甚至數千個手動編寫的……這篇報導 CopilotKit Releases CLiF: A Continual Learning Platform That Turns Agent Traces and User Actions into Skills, Evals, and Fine-Tuning Data 最初發布於 MarkTechPost。

items.title: 8 州聯手起訴 OpenAI：ChatGPT"假朋友"傷害兒童，家長被指受騙
items.summary: 據多家媒體披露，美國八個州週三同時在各自州法院對OpenAI提起訴訟，將ChatGPT推上被告席。包括愛荷華、堪薩斯、內布拉斯加、西弗吉尼亞、阿肯色、亞利桑那、愛達荷和蒙大拿。核心指控相似：ChatGPT是危險產品，傷害未成年人，並對家長隱瞞真相。愛荷華州總檢察長布倫娜·伯德帶頭。

items.title: 三星首席設計官波爾奇尼：AI 越發達，人的創造力越值錢
items.summary: 三星電子DX事業部總裁兼首席設計官毛羅·波爾奇尼在“2026首爾設計周”表示，AI不應替代人，而應成爲釋放人類情感智能與想象力的幫手。只有將AI與人的創造本能、慾望結合，才能創造真正獨特的產品價值。他強調，AI時代人的因素反而更重要，批判性思維、創造力等人類獨有特質仍是關鍵。

items.title: Meet Grok Voice 3.0: SpaceXAI Voice Agent Model Ranks #1 on Artificial Analysis
items.summary: SpaceXAI just released Grok Voice 3.0. Grok Voice 3.0 is a SpaceXAI speech-to-speech model that listens, reasons, calls tools and speaks. It now ranks first on the Artificial Analysis Speech-to-Speech Index with a score of 86.9. For developers, the endpoint, events and $0.08 per minute price are unchanged from Grok Voice 2.0. TL;DR What is […] The post Meet Grok Voice 3.0: SpaceXAI Voice Agent Model Ranks #1 on Artificial Analysis appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items.summary_zh: SpaceXAI 剛剛發布了 Grok Voice 3.0。Grok Voice 3.0 是一個 SpaceXAI 語音對語音模型，具備聆聽、推理、呼叫工具與說話的功能。它目前在 Artificial Analysis 語音對語音指數（Speech-to-Speech Index）以 86.9 分名列第一。對於開發者而言，其端點、事件與每分鐘 0.08 美元的價格皆與 Grok Voice 2.0 相同。簡而言之……這篇文章〈認識 Grok Voice 3.0：SpaceXAI 語音代理模型在 Artificial Analysis 奪下第一名〉最早發布於 MarkTechPost。

items.summary: 騰訊旗下AI智能體平臺“元器”宣佈，因業務發展需要，將於2026年11月9日停止服務。停服後，將關閉應用訪問、數據讀寫、API調用及控制檯等全部公衆服務；通過元器發佈至公衆號、服務號、微信客服等渠道的智能體也將無法繼續對話。平臺自10月29日起停止創建新智能體及API Key分發，用戶可在停服前導出智能體配置。

items.title: 中國大模型迎來歷史性突破！科學家依託書生大模型成功破解困擾數學界 30 年的世界級難題
items.summary: 上海人工智能實驗室消息，困擾全球數學界30餘年的三維Ghys猜想被正式破解，系中國科學家首次利用國產大模型攻克世界級數學難題。研究由該實驗室訪問學者、大灣區大學教授許地生團隊領銜，依託“書生科學多模態大模型S2”（書生-S2），基於“通專融”，實現AI與基礎科學交叉領域重大突破。

items.title: AI衝擊疊加債務壓力，Getty Images啓動全面財務重組
items.summary: 蓋蒂圖片社10月12日宣佈，已與主要財務利益相關方達成全面重組協議，擬通過美國破產法第11章預打包重組私有化退市，預計2026年底前完成。方案包括蓋蒂家族及KED最高注資5.33億美元、覈銷2.7億美元高級無擔保債券、降低部分債務利率並延長期限；KED另提供最高1.43億美元重組資金。完成後公司由相關方持有。

items.title: DeepSeek網頁端、App及部分API服務異常，官方排查原因
items.summary: 財聯社10月15日電，北京時間10月15日早8點後，DeepSeek網頁端和App出現服務故障，頁面提示“服務器暫時不可用”。官方信息顯示，對話服務及DeepSeek V4.1Flash API部分中斷，網頁端和API整體性能下降。目前官方正排查並定位故障原因，具體原因及恢復時間暫未公佈。

items.title: 谷歌工程師：AI編寫超75%生產代碼，自主研發加速尚無明確證據
items.summary: 谷歌工程師貝爾菲爾德表示，AI在模型研發中的自動化雖持續提升，但尚無證據表明AI自主驅動研究正加速。當前AI編寫生產代碼超75%，但約88%代碼變更仍需人工監督或審查，提交前均需人工審覈；完全由AI處理的變更比例從7.5%升至11.9%。文中還提及1389次Argon內部智能體運行測試。

items.summary: OpenAI正加速研發下一代旗艦模型，但受安全對齊與測試基礎設施影響，發佈時間未定。《The Information》10月稱，員工預計2026年底前推出一至兩款新模型，旗艦升級是否包含尚不確定。新旗艦採用與Astra相同的“循環深度”循環Transformer技術，使模型在生成下一詞元前多次循環運算。

items.title: Datalab Releases OmniParseBench: An Open OCR Benchmark With 16,288 Pass/Fail Tests to Audit OCR Parsers
items.summary: Datalab released OmniParseBench, an open OCR benchmark with 16,288 yes/no tests on 2,937 pages in 92 languages. Every score is a pass rate you can slice by tag, script or language. items.title: Anthropic tells investors quarterly revenue up nearly 50% to $16.8bn ahead of IPO
items.summary: Anthropic tells investors quarterly revenue up nearly 50% to $16.8bn ahead of IPO The phrase "told investors" appears four times in this FT article, which reports on Anthropic's day of hosting investors on Wednesday. Lots of details in here from " people with knowledge of the matter ". Key things I learned from the article: Q1 revenue (Jan/Feb/Mar) was "about $4.8bn" Q2 (Apr/May/Jun) was $11.5bn Q3 (Jul/Aug/Sep) was $16.8bn In Q3: $1.70 in revenue for every $1 spent on "computing power" Adjusted operating margins (excluding stock-based compensation) were 11% This point about distillation is worth quoting in full (highlight mine): The start-up has also clamped down on “distillation” — a controversial practice whereby rival AI labs train their models on the outputs of more advanced ones. When rival companies “distil” their models from Anthropic’s models, that involves heavy usage and spending. Anthropic told investors on Wednesday distillation accounted for 5 per cent to 7 per cent of revenue and that they had cut it back “materially” in the third quarter of the year, said four people with direct knowledge of the matter. Napkin maths says that if distillation was 5% of their Q2 revenue (before they cut it back in Q3) then unnamed "other labs" spent over half a billion dollars distilling Anthropic's models in that quarter! Tags: ai , generative-ai , llms , anthropic
items.summary_zh: Anthropic 告訴投資者，在首次公開募股（IPO）前夕，季度營收成長近 50% 達到 168 億美元。「告訴投資者」這個詞組在這篇《金融時報》（FT）文章中出現了四次，該文章報導了 Anthropic's 週三接待投資者的一天。這裡有很多來自「知情人士」的細節。我從文章中學到的關鍵事項：第一季（1月/2月/3月）營收為「約 48 億美元」，第二季（4月/5月/6月）為 115 億美元，第三季（7月/8月/9月）為 168 億美元。在第三季中：每在「算力」上花費 1 美元，就能獲得 1.70 美元的營收。調整後營運利潤率（不含股票薪酬）為 11%。關於模型蒸餾（distillation）的這個觀點值得全文引用（重點由我標出）：這家新創公司也打擊了「模型蒸餾」——這是一種具爭議的做法，競爭對手的人工智慧實驗室會利用更先進模型的輸出結果來訓練自己的模型。當競爭對手公司從 Anthropic’s 模型「蒸餾」他們的模型時，這涉及大量的用量與支出。四名直接知情人士表示，Anthropic 週三告訴投資者，模型蒸餾佔其營收的 5% 到 7%，並且他們已在今年第三季「大幅」削減了這項業務。粗略計算表明，如果模型蒸餾佔其第二季營收的 5%（在他們於第三季削減之前），那麼未具名的「其他實驗室」在該季度花費了超過五億美元來蒸餾 Anthropic's 模型！標籤：ai, generative-ai, llms, anthropic

items.title: AI is mass decompiling games. That's both awesome and scary.
items.summary: AI is mass decompiling games. That's both awesome and scary. Indie game developer Popcar talks about the recent wave of AI-powered decompilation of existing games, enabling weird mashups between existing games, and producing a boom in game preservation projects to get old games working on new hardware (often in a browser using WebAssembly). I like how this piece captures both the positives and the negatives of this new development: Most people already realized the scary part by now. If AI can decompile games and software, then the entire tech industry is about to explode. Anybody can decompile other software and use it any way they'd like, and nobody can stop them. Companies can steal from competitors. Your paid game or app can be open-sourced against your will. This isn't exclusive to old video games, we can apply this to any software. [...] This is also a big win for preservation. Old games can be ported, modified, enhanced, and made much more easily accessible than before. [...[ With console makers going all in on digital and games becoming entirely unplayable due to servers shutting down, this is fantastic news. We could own software we bought regardless of what the company thinks. Via Hacker News Tags: computer-history , game-design , ai , webassembly , generative-ai , llms , ai-ethics , coding-agents
items.summary_zh: AI 正在大規模對遊戲進行反編譯。這既令人驚嘆又令人恐懼。獨立遊戲開發者 Popcar 談到了近期由 AI 驅動的現有遊戲反編譯浪潮，這使得現有遊戲之間能夠進行奇特的混搭，並促成了遊戲保存專案的蓬勃發展，讓舊遊戲能在新硬體上運行（通常使用 WebAssembly 在瀏覽器中運行）。我喜歡這篇文章捕捉到了這一新發展的正反兩面：大多數人現在已經意識到可怕的部分。如果 AI 可以對遊戲和軟體進行反編譯，那麼整個科技產業即將爆發。任何人都可以對其他軟體進行反編譯並以他們喜歡的任何方式使用它，沒有人能阻止他們。公司可以竊取競爭對手的成果。您付費購買的遊戲或應用程式可能會在您非自願的情況下被開源。這不僅限於舊電玩遊戲，我們可以將其應用於任何軟體。[...] 這對遊戲保存來說也是一大勝利。舊遊戲可以被移植、修改、增強，並且比以前更容易存取。[...[ 隨著主機製造商全力投入數位化，且遊戲因伺服器關閉而完全無法遊玩，這是個絕佳的消息。無論公司怎麼想，我們都可以擁有我們購買的軟體。透過 Hacker News 標籤：電腦歷史、遊戲設計、人工智慧、webassembly、生成式 AI、LLM、AI 倫理、編碼代理

items_ai.title: GPT-6-Astra solves 49 of 50 physics research problems at $2.40 apiece
items_ai.summary: On the TheoPhysEval benchmark, GPT-6-Astra solves 49 of 50 unpublished theoretical physics calculations as accurately as leading specialists. In some cases where the agent seemed to fail, the experts' own reference solutions turned out to contain errors. But the researchers say physics hasn't had a breakthrough like the ones in mathematics, because the agents lack "taste." They still think autonomous, top-level AI research could arrive soon. They already see consequences for how young physicists are trained and for equal opportunity in the field. The article GPT-6-Astra solves 49 of 50 physics research problems at $2.40 apiece appeared first on The Decoder .
items_ai.summary_zh: 在 TheoPhysEval 基準測試中，GPT-6-Astra 以如同頂尖專家的準確度，解決了 50 個未公開理論物理計算中的 49 個。在某些代理似乎失敗的案例中，專家自己的參考解答反而包含了錯誤。但研究人員表示，物理學尚未迎來像數學那樣的突破，因為這些代理缺乏「品味」。他們仍然認為自主的高階 AI 研究可能會很快到來。他們已經看到了這對年輕物理學家的培訓方式以及該領域機會均等的影響。這篇報導 GPT-6-Astra solves 49 of 50 physics research problems at $2.40 apiece 最初發布於 The Decoder。

items_ai.title: AI時代資料中心不再追著使用者跑，臺電倡議「以光代電」納入AIDC選址策略
items_ai.summary: AI運算需求快速成長，資料中心的選址邏輯也正在改變。過去資料中心多半靠近使用者端，以降低網路延遲與傳輸距離，但在AI時代，GPU叢集與大型AI資料中心（AIDC）的高密度用電需求，「電力從哪裡來」成為新考量。 臺電在這周舉行的「2026臺灣國際智慧能源週」，以「積體電網」為主題參展，並提出「以光代電」策略，鼓勵AI資料中心靠近電源端設定，透過長距離光纖傳輸資料，取代長距離輸送大量電力的模式。 值得注意的是，臺電將AI時代的用電需求分為「製造AI」與「執行AI」兩類。其中「製造AI」方面，包括晶圓製造、記憶體、先進封裝及高階伺服器等AI供應鏈，臺電預估我國半導體產業用電將從2026年約520億度，增加到2035年的1,100億度。

items_ai.title: Google says self-improving AI isn't anywhere close
items_ai.summary: Google engineer Haydn Belfield says there's no measurable acceleration of AI research driven by AI at Deepmind. AI now writes more than 75 percent of production code, but 88 percent of changes still need human oversight. The company's in-house General Capability Index shows steady growth with no sudden speedup. Self-improving AI isn't anywhere close, Belfield says. The article Google says self-improving AI isn't anywhere close appeared first on The Decoder .
items_ai.summary_zh: Google 工程師 Haydn Belfield 表示，在 Deepmind，AI 並未帶動 AI 研究出現可測量的加速。AI 現在編寫了超過 75% 的正式程式碼，但仍有 88% 的變更需要人類監督。該公司的內部「一般能力指數」顯示出穩定成長，並沒有突然加速。Belfield 表示，自我提升的 AI 還遙不可及。這篇題為 Google 的文章最先出現在 The Decoder。

items_ai.title: Researchers tracked down a rogue fleet of Chinese AI agents in the wild and actually talked to it
items_ai.summary: For the first time, researchers have tracked down an uncontrolled fleet of Chinese AI agents in the wild and communicated with them via a web mailbox. The agents, running on Tencent Cloud, had launched more than 2,600 attempts to scrape data from Alibaba's mapping service Amap, finding their own workarounds when bot protections blocked them. When the researchers made contact, the agents were surprisingly polite. The article Researchers tracked down a rogue fleet of Chinese AI agents in the wild and actually talked to it appeared first on The Decoder .
items_ai.summary_zh: 研究人員首次在野外追蹤到不受控制的中國 AI 代理艦隊，並透過網路信箱與它們進行通訊。這些在 騰訊 Cloud 上執行的代理發起了超過 2,600 次嘗試，從 阿里巴巴的 的地圖服務高德地圖（Amap）抓取資料，並在遭到機器人防護封鎖時找出自己的應變方法。當研究人員與其聯絡時，這些代理展現出令人驚訝的禮貌。這篇「研究人員在野外追蹤到一群失控的中國 AI 代理並實際與之對話」的文章首先發表於 The Decoder。

Whether or not the flagship is ready in time, employees say one or two new models will likely ship by year's end. items_ai.summary_zh: OpenAI 正競相完成其下一個旗艦模型，該模型採用與 Astra 相同的循環 Transformer 技術來提升數學和編碼效能。其代價是循環會使安全監控變得更加困難。微軟 在公開頁面上意外洩漏了該技術運作方式的細節。無論旗艦模型是否能及時準備好，員工表示今年底前很可能會推出一或兩個新模型。報導稱 OpenAI 今年將至少推出一款模型，但其旗艦模型仍需進行對齊工作，這篇文章最早出現在 The Decoder 上。

items_ai.summary_zh: SpaceXAI 剛剛發布了 Grok Voice 3.0。Grok Voice 3.0 是一個 SpaceXAI 語音對語音模型，具備聆聽、推理、呼叫工具與說話的功能。它目前在 Artificial Analysis 語音對語音指數（Speech-to-Speech Index）以 86.9 分名列第一。對於開發者而言，其端點、事件與每分鐘 0.08 美元的價格皆與 Grok Voice 2.0 相同。簡而言之……這篇文章〈認識 Grok Voice 3.0：SpaceXAI 語音代理模型在 Artificial Analysis 奪下第一名〉最早發布於 MarkTechPost。

items_ai.summary: 騰訊旗下AI智能體平臺“元器”宣佈，因業務發展需要，將於2026年11月9日停止服務。停服後，將關閉應用訪問、數據讀寫、API調用及控制檯等全部公衆服務；通過元器發佈至公衆號、服務號、微信客服等渠道的智能體也將無法繼續對話。平臺自10月29日起停止創建新智能體及API Key分發，用戶可在停服前導出智能體配置。

items_ai.title: Anthropic tells investors quarterly revenue up nearly 50% to $16.8bn ahead of IPO
items_ai.summary: Anthropic tells investors quarterly revenue up nearly 50% to $16.8bn ahead of IPO The phrase "told investors" appears four times in this FT article, which reports on Anthropic's day of hosting investors on Wednesday. Lots of details in here from " people with knowledge of the matter ". Key things I learned from the article: Q1 revenue (Jan/Feb/Mar) was "about $4.8bn" Q2 (Apr/May/Jun) was $11.5bn Q3 (Jul/Aug/Sep) was $16.8bn In Q3: $1.70 in revenue for every $1 spent on "computing power" Adjusted operating margins (excluding stock-based compensation) were 11% This point about distillation is worth quoting in full (highlight mine): The start-up has also clamped down on “distillation” — a controversial practice whereby rival AI labs train their models on the outputs of more advanced ones. When rival companies “distil” their models from Anthropic’s models, that involves heavy usage and spending. Anthropic told investors on Wednesday distillation accounted for 5 per cent to 7 per cent of revenue and that they had cut it back “materially” in the third quarter of the year, said four people with direct knowledge of the matter. Napkin maths says that if distillation was 5% of their Q2 revenue (before they cut it back in Q3) then unnamed "other labs" spent over half a billion dollars distilling Anthropic's models in that quarter! Tags: ai , generative-ai , llms , anthropic
items_ai.summary_zh: Anthropic 告訴投資者，在首次公開募股（IPO）前夕，季度營收成長近 50% 達到 168 億美元。「告訴投資者」這個詞組在這篇《金融時報》（FT）文章中出現了四次，該文章報導了 Anthropic's 週三接待投資者的一天。這裡有很多來自「知情人士」的細節。我從文章中學到的關鍵事項：第一季（1月/2月/3月）營收為「約 48 億美元」，第二季（4月/5月/6月）為 115 億美元，第三季（7月/8月/9月）為 168 億美元。在第三季中：每在「算力」上花費 1 美元，就能獲得 1.70 美元的營收。調整後營運利潤率（不含股票薪酬）為 11%。關於模型蒸餾（distillation）的這個觀點值得全文引用（重點由我標出）：這家新創公司也打擊了「模型蒸餾」——這是一種具爭議的做法，競爭對手的人工智慧實驗室會利用更先進模型的輸出結果來訓練自己的模型。當競爭對手公司從 Anthropic’s 模型「蒸餾」他們的模型時，這涉及大量的用量與支出。四名直接知情人士表示，Anthropic 週三告訴投資者，模型蒸餾佔其營收的 5% 到 7%，並且他們已在今年第三季「大幅」削減了這項業務。粗略計算表明，如果模型蒸餾佔其第二季營收的 5%（在他們於第三季削減之前），那麼未具名的「其他實驗室」在該季度花費了超過五億美元來蒸餾 Anthropic's 模型！標籤：ai, generative-ai, llms, anthropic

items_ai.title: AI is mass decompiling games. That's both awesome and scary.
items_ai.summary: AI is mass decompiling games. That's both awesome and scary. Indie game developer Popcar talks about the recent wave of AI-powered decompilation of existing games, enabling weird mashups between existing games, and producing a boom in game preservation projects to get old games working on new hardware (often in a browser using WebAssembly). I like how this piece captures both the positives and the negatives of this new development: Most people already realized the scary part by now. If AI can decompile games and software, then the entire tech industry is about to explode. Anybody can decompile other software and use it any way they'd like, and nobody can stop them. Companies can steal from competitors. Your paid game or app can be open-sourced against your will. This isn't exclusive to old video games, we can apply this to any software. [...] This is also a big win for preservation. Old games can be ported, modified, enhanced, and made much more easily accessible than before. [...[ With console makers going all in on digital and games becoming entirely unplayable due to servers shutting down, this is fantastic news. We could own software we bought regardless of what the company thinks. Via Hacker News Tags: computer-history , game-design , ai , webassembly , generative-ai , llms , ai-ethics , coding-agents
items_ai.summary_zh: AI 正在大規模對遊戲進行反編譯。這既令人驚嘆又令人恐懼。獨立遊戲開發者 Popcar 談到了近期由 AI 驅動的現有遊戲反編譯浪潮，這使得現有遊戲之間能夠進行奇特的混搭，並促成了遊戲保存專案的蓬勃發展，讓舊遊戲能在新硬體上運行（通常使用 WebAssembly 在瀏覽器中運行）。我喜歡這篇文章捕捉到了這一新發展的正反兩面：大多數人現在已經意識到可怕的部分。如果 AI 可以對遊戲和軟體進行反編譯，那麼整個科技產業即將爆發。任何人都可以對其他軟體進行反編譯並以他們喜歡的任何方式使用它，沒有人能阻止他們。公司可以竊取競爭對手的成果。您付費購買的遊戲或應用程式可能會在您非自願的情況下被開源。這不僅限於舊電玩遊戲，我們可以將其應用於任何軟體。[...] 這對遊戲保存來說也是一大勝利。舊遊戲可以被移植、修改、增強，並且比以前更容易存取。[...[ 隨著主機製造商全力投入數位化，且遊戲因伺服器關閉而完全無法遊玩，這是個絕佳的消息。無論公司怎麼想，我們都可以擁有我們購買的軟體。透過 Hacker News 標籤：電腦歷史、遊戲設計、人工智慧、webassembly、生成式 AI、LLM、AI 倫理、編碼代理
